args: Frames 1–4 (ladder) are good — keep them exactly. Frames 5–10: REMOVE the rope and the line completely; draw only the character, nothing in his paws, the game draws the rope and the zipline itself. Frames 5–8 must differ clearly: 5 right paw high and left paw at chest, legs pulled up; 6 left paw high, right paw at chest, legs stretched down; 7 like 5 but body higher; 8 like 6 but body higher. Frames 9–10: both front paws raised straight above the head gripping nothing, body hanging, legs and tail swinging forward in 9 and backward in 10. Every frame faces RIGHT.
